title: Move Checklist Task Weekly Days Before Move Trend
dataSources: Move checklists (`move:checklist`), USPS change-of-address (`usps:change`), mover quotes (`mover:quote`), utility transfers (`utility:transfer`), and box inventories (`box:inventory`).
app: Move checklist task exports, USPS change-of-address confirmations, mover quote comparisons, utility transfer logs, and box inventory scans forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=move:checklist days_before_move=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(days_before_move) as avg_duration, max(days_before_move) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst days before move for move checklist task events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture days_before_move on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average days before move with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether move checklist task tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
